steps.intro: Welcome to GAFS A-Watch. This is the Administration portal for Gamu Agri-Fishery School.
steps.login: Sign in with your admin email and password, then click Sign In.
steps.dashboard: The dashboard shows school-wide attendance statistics and charts.
steps.blocks.view: Program Blocks are home sections for students, such as Grade 10 Malunggay.
steps.blocks.add: Click Add Program Block, enter the block name and year level, then save.
steps.blocks.edit: To edit a block, click the pencil icon, update the name, and save.
steps.blocks.delete: To delete a block, click the delete icon and confirm.
steps.subjects.view: Subjects are courses like Mathematics or Agri-Fishery Technology.
steps.subjects.add: Add a new subject by clicking Add Subject and entering the name.
steps.subjects.edit: Edit a subject using the pencil icon on its row.
steps.subjects.delete: Remove a subject with the delete icon.
steps.teachers.view: The Teachers page lists all teacher accounts and their assigned classes.
steps.teachers.add: Add a teacher with name, email, and password.
steps.teachers.edit: Update a teacher's name using the edit dialog.
steps.teachers.delete: Delete a teacher account when they leave the school.
steps.students.view: Students are listed with their number, section, and enrollment count.
steps.students.add: Add a student with personal details, home program block, and parent email.
steps.students.edit: Edit student information using the pencil icon.
steps.students.delete: Delete a student record when needed.
steps.classes.view: Classes link teachers to subjects and program blocks.
steps.classes.add: Click Assign Classes to add subject and block pairs for a teacher.
steps.enrollments.view: Enrollments connect students to their classes. Select a student to manage enrollments.
steps.reports.view: Reports let you filter attendance by date range and export a PDF summary.
steps.outro: That completes the admin walkthrough. Thank you for watching.
